pages.title: Under Control
pages.text: The red chalk is made from the very essence of Afrit, making its glyphs directly$(br) connected to these spirits. Additionally, it elevates the pentacles$(br)  capacity to the most demonic levels.$(br)
These properties allow for an incredible achievement that has been sought$(br) for ages before being attained: the summoning of an Afrit bound to the occultist.$(br)
To obtain the essence of an $(#AA00AA)Afrit$() for $(item)Red Chalk$() you need to$(br) $(l:summoning_rituals/afrit_essence)summon and kill an Unbound Afrit$(/l).$(br)
